question: Should outbound recovery keep ambiguous entries pending with backoff when no reconciliation-capable adapter is available, once the no-op deferral no longer consumes send-replay pacing?
rationale: Tests can prove the queue mechanics, but choosing pending recoverability over a terminal failed/operator-visible state is a product and operations tradeoff for existing ambiguous rows.

options.title: Accept Recoverable Pending After Pacing Fix
options.body: Merge after the pacing defect and exact-head validation are fixed if maintainers want ambiguous no-adapter entries to remain recoverable until adapter reconciliation ships.

options.title: Keep Fail-Closed State
options.body: Pause or close this PR and keep current main's terminal failed behavior until the broader delivery ledger design is ready.

options.title: Require Operator Surfacing First
options.body: Ask for a visible doctor, UI, or API path before changing ambiguous entries to remain pending longer.

recommendation.title: Accept Recoverable Pending After Pacing Fix
recommendation.body: Merge after the pacing defect and exact-head validation are fixed if maintainers want ambiguous no-adapter entries to remain recoverable until adapter reconciliation ships.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision crosses durable message lifecycle, SQLite queue migration, and recent recovery/pacing merge history where steipete is the clearest recurring owner signal.
